title: Advantage+ Campaigns
objectives: Understand Meta's Advantage+ suite (Advantage+ Shopping, Creative, and Placements)
Identify what machine learning automates and what the human strategist controls
Configure Existing Customer Budget Caps to protect new customer acquisition

blocks.text: Advantage+ is Meta's flagship AI automation suite. Let's see how smart media buyers use it to dominate sales!
Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC) use deep learning to automate audience targeting, budget allocation, and placement delivery in a single consolidated campaign.

headers: What YOU Still Control as Strategist
rows: Creative asset quality, video scripting & hooks

blocks.title: The Self-Driving Sports Car
blocks.text: Advantage+ is like a high-tech Tesla on autopilot. The car handles steering and speed, but YOU choose the destination and fill the tank with premium fuel (high-converting creative hooks)!
Existing Customer Cap: In account settings, upload your customer list and cap existing customer spend at 10% to 15%. This prevents Meta from taking the easy route of re-selling to loyal buyers!
Do not feed ASC only 1 or 2 static images. Advantage+ thrives when you upload at least 8 to 15 diverse creative assets (video Reels, UGC, carousels).

quiz.q: What is the critical setting in Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns that ensures budget is spent finding NEW customers rather than retargeting existing buyers?
quiz.explain: Setting an Existing Customer Budget Cap (e.g. max 15%) restricts how much spend is allocated to past buyers.

quiz.q: With Advantage+ automating targeting and bidding, what becomes the media buyer's most important competitive lever?
options: Creative Strategy: Video hooks, authentic UGC angles, and compelling customer offers
quiz.explain: In automated environments, creative is the targeting: high-converting hooks and offers drive 90% of results.

quiz.q: What is a recommended minimum number of creative assets to upload into an Advantage+ Shopping Campaign?
options: At least 8 to 15 diverse assets (Reels, Carousels, UGC)
quiz.explain: Meta's AI needs variety to mix and match visuals, copy, and formats across different user preferences.

quiz.q: True or False: Advantage+ campaigns completely eliminate the need for human media buyers.
quiz.explain: False! Strategists are needed more than ever to direct creative psychology, unit economics, and data architecture.

recap: Advantage+ automates audience matching and placement distribution.
Strategists control creative quality, offers, and the Existing Customer Budget Cap.
